subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: What active-run recovery contract should Control UI own after a WebSocket reconnect for sessions that are still running?
rationale: Current main has gateway state and partial UI mitigations, but not a complete Control UI adoption path; the remaining fix overlaps a conflicting PR and narrower issues, so maintainers need to choose the permanent contract before another autonomous fix lane.

options.title: Narrow current-main recovery
options.body: Use the existing filtered `chat.history.inFlightRun` and session active-run projection to restore Control UI busy/in-flight state, with live reconnect proof before closure.

options.title: Revive the snapshot PR
options.body: Rework the linked `activeChatRuns` snapshot PR into a clean, protocol-reviewed, proof-backed implementation.

options.title: Accept partial mitigation
options.body: Document that reconnect may not restore in-flight output and close this issue only if maintainers intentionally accept the current behavior.

recommendation.title: Narrow current-main recovery
recommendation.body: Use the existing filtered `chat.history.inFlightRun` and session active-run projection to restore Control UI busy/in-flight state, with live reconnect proof before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main refactor and adjacent ownership make this the best available routing owner for choosing the Control UI/Gateway recovery boundary.
